title: Eliminate hover jitter + standardize spinner placement for icon and compound buttons
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Background: Multiple regressions surfaced after the token migration and recent CSS refactor: 1) visual 'shift' (jitter) when hovering compact icon-only and icon+label buttons due to outline and padding recalculation; 2) inconsistent spinner placement across primary/ghost/outline variants leading to clipped icons and perceived layout jumps; 3) dark-theme contrast regressions for disabled buttons in high-density lists.

Goal: Provide a single, token-driven solution that: stabilizes hover/focus outlines without changing hitbox, unifies spinner placement (leading/trailing/overlay) for all button variants, restores disabled contrast parity across themes, and documents patterns so engineers can adopt without fragile CSS overrides.

Scope: icon-only buttons, icon+label (compound) buttons, primary/secondary/ghost/outline variants, loading states, disabled states, focus/hover outlines, theme tokens.

Out-of-scope: major layout changes to button grid or moving to a new DOM structure.
acceptance_criteria: Hover/focus outlines no longer cause layout shift for icon-only and compact buttons across supported browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari)
Spinner position is consistent (centered overlay for icon-only; left-of-label inline for compound buttons) for all variants and respects RTL flows
Disabled state color tokens meet WCAG AA contrast for foreground vs background in both light and dark themes
All changes are driven by tokens or classes (no one-off style patches) and documented in the component spec
Unit/regression visual test added to Percy/storyshots and CI passes
Design review and engineering sign-off completed; rollout plan with canary for console and platform components defined
comments: 2026-03-02 - Aisha K: Filed after QA reported hover jump in console table rows; attached visual diffs. Marked as P1 due to regression impact on admin workflows.
2026-03-04 - Mateo R: Prototyped approach: move outline to a ::after pseudo element with absolute positioning to avoid layout reflow. Requires token for outline-offset and z-index contract.
2026-03-06 - Design review: Team prefers centered overlay spinner for icon-only to avoid width changes; compound buttons should use leading inline spinner so label baseline remains stable.

2026-03-08 - Eng review (Chen Li): Suggested avoiding :focus-visible outline removal; instead use transform-free outline implementation for accessibility. Flagged potential Safari subpixel rounding issue.
2026-03-10 - Mateo R: Implemented token changes in ui-kit branch and added visual regression tests. Spinner positioning uses --button-spinner-mode token (overlay|inline-left|inline-right).

2026-03-12 - QA (Sofia Patel): Ran cross-browser checks. Chrome/Firefox good. Noticed 1px vertical misalignment in Safari 15 for compact icon-only buttons when devicePixelRatio=2; created ENG-5804 as follow-up.
2026-03-13 - PM (Ravi Menon): Confirmed rollout window aligned with runtime-1.20 console deploy. Request to include a short migration note for integrators about new tokens.
notes: Decision: Use token --button-spinner-mode and --button-outline-layer to let platform teams opt into new behavior gradually.
Trade-offs: Pseudo-element outline avoids layout shift but adds one extra stacking context; validated with perf team that cost is negligible for button counts used in lists.
Rollout plan: ship behind feature flag for console; enable for new Dedicated UI routes first; monitor Percy diffs and Console error dashboards for unexpected regressions.
QA checklist: visual snapshots for 6 variants x 2 sizes x 2 themes x loading/disabled states; keyboard-only focus verification; screen reader label verification when spinner is present.
